content.summary: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance Plus has spent the last few days getting review-bombed on Steam after it was discovered that a particular segment of the game used AI music. Reddit user ShweetsStuff discovered the songs used during a Grand Theft Auto-themed section. They found several audio files with Suno metadata that pointed back to the tracks on Suno's site. Creator Edmund McMillen took to X to apologize and claimed he "had no idea" the in-game GTA parody used generative AI music.
